name: weavers-cottage-savanna
description: Weaver's Cottage, the savanna look (ROADMAP 49.10d): the shipped Weaver's Cottage drawn again as a herder-weaver's house: one golden thatch hip over red granite and packed mud with a painted band, a veranda on acacia posts before the weaver's window, the flock in a kraal with its own little thatched shelter and (II) a walled dye garden with a drying frame and an acacia. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes candidates.
